AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Offline Islamic prayer companion for Turkey (Diyanet calculation method). Everything runs on the device; no account and no network are needed. Operational patterns: - 'siradakiNamaz' answers questions about the current and the next prayer time; read its 'ozet' field to the user. - 'simdikiVaktiKildim' marks the current prayer as performed in two steps: call it once without 'onayKimligi', ask the user the returned 'onaySorusu', and call it again with the returned 'onayKimligi' only after an explicit yes. - 'kibleyiAc' opens the Qibla compass screen. Constraints: - Answers are in Turkish and are based on the location saved in the app. - A prayer can only be marked while its time window is running; nothing can be marked between sunrise and noon.
AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:displayDescription: Namaz vakitlerini sorabilir, şu anki vakti kılındı olarak işaretleyebilir ve Kıble ekranını açabilirsiniz.
